caption: The drawing depicts a single, light brown or tan leather shoe, presented in a profile view facing left. The shoe has a soft, rounded toe and a slightly raised back around the ankle. It is secured with laces that run through a series of eyelets along the right side, from the instep to the top, where the laces are tied in a simple bow. The stitching and subtle folds of the leather are visible, suggesting a slightly worn look. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or shadows. In the upper left corner, there is a rectangular label with text inside it, and in the bottom right corner, there is printed text noting the Federal Art Project and other details.
title: Wedding Shoe
